title: Record the split-budget survivors
body:
## Summary
- Of the 66 length-20 weight splits with parts at most 10, the even budget and the pair identity leave `(10,10)`, `(10,9)`, `(10,8)`, `(9,9)` and `(10,7)`.
- The split `(9,8)` has budget 1 and need 4, and every admissible product `a*b` is 0, so it drops out. At length 18 only `(9,9)` survives, among 55 splits.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged, and this check does not decide `f(7)`.
